title: Surreal Moonlit Watcher
description: A surreal night landscape features a large twisted tree-like creature with a long neck and a single large eye for a head, standing in a golden grassy field. The dark blue starry sky contains three moons of varying sizes, a distant gothic castle silhouette, and a massive swirling green vortex on the left.
